# epilot-taxonomy_taxonomy (Resource)

Taxonomy Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "epilot-taxonomy_taxonomy" "my_taxonomy" {
  color   = "#FF5733"
  enabled = true
  enabled_locations = [
    "..."
  ]
  icon      = "purpose"
  name      = "Purpose"
  order     = 10
  permanent = false
  plural    = "Purposes"
  slug      = "purpose"
  type      = "entity"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `color` (String) HEX Color code for the taxonomy
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the taxonomy is enabled or not
- `enabled_locations` (List of String) List of locations where the taxonomy is enabled to be used. If empty, it's enabled for all locations.
- `icon` (String) Icon name for the taxonomy (from epilot360/icons icon set)
- `name` (String) A human friendly name of a Taxonomy e.g. Purpose, Product Category, Folder, Tag
- `order` (Number) Position of the taxonomy
- `permanent` (Boolean) ⚠️ NOT IMPLEMENTED - If true, the taxonomy will be permanently deleted. Default: false
- `plural` (String) Plural name of a Taxonomy e.g. Purposes, Product Categories, Folders, Tags. Defaults to name is not provided.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly name for taxonomy
- `type` (String) Type of taxonomy. Whether it classifies:
- entity (default)
- relation (for relations)
- system (for system taxonomies - default for all slugs starting with _system_)
- file_collection (for file collections)
Default: "entity"; must be one of ["entity", "relation", "system", "file_collection"]

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String) User ID of the creator
- `deleted_at` (String) Date when the taxonomy was soft-deleted (enabled: false)
- `kind` (String) Kind of taxonomy e.g. system or user_defined. By default, it's empty, which means 'user_defined'
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = epilot-taxonomy_taxonomy.my_epilot-taxonomy_taxonomy
  id = "purpose"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import epilot-taxonomy_taxonomy.my_epilot-taxonomy_taxonomy "purpose"
```
